newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks slip in London as Dow eases.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks slip in London as Dow eases.

text.p: Japanese blue chips were a bit softer in London on Tuesday afternoon, after Tokyo's strong rally.
Dealers said Japanese shares slipped on profit-taking on the expected pullback on Wall Street after Monday's record-setting rally.
"The market is acting like a puppet of New York," said one London dealer.
Shares in Kyocera Corp, TDK Corp AND NEC Corp were among the most active hit hardest in London, he said.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 average jumped 666.17 points, or 3.4 percent, to 20,180.92.
